question:

help students learn better and the results were inconclusive. Students who needed 
external stimulation for studying fared worse while students who did not need 
any external stimulation benefited from music.

passage?

Listening to music has no effect on learning and a positive effect on physical 
exercise.
options.B:
Listening to music has a clear positive effect both on physical exercise and on 
learning.
options.C:
Listening to music has a clear positive effect on physical exercise. Music has a 
positive effect on learning only in some students.
options.D:

has a positive effect only in some students who exercise.
